find_base_href.brief: 查找文档的 `<base href>` / Find the document's `<base href>`

params.node: 开始查找的 DOM 节点，递归其子树 / DOM node to search from, recursing into its subtree

find_base_href.return: 首个非空 `href` 的指针（由 DOM 拥有），未找到返回 `NULL` / Pointer to the first non-empty `href` owned by the DOM, `NULL` when none
find_base_href.note: 深度优先遍历；按规范首个带非空 href 的 `<base>` 生效 / Depth-first; per spec the first `<base>` with a non-empty href wins

resolve_url.brief: 把文档相对地址解析为绝对路径 / Resolve a document-relative reference to an absolute path

params.engine: 引擎实例，提供 `<base href>` / Engine instance, supplies `<base href>`
params.out: out:接收绝对路径的缓冲区 / Buffer that receives the absolute path
params.out_size: 输出缓冲区容量（字节）/ Capacity of the output buffer in bytes
params.dir: 文档所在目录 / Directory of the document
params.rel: 待解析的相对引用 / Relative reference to resolve

resolve_url.note: 存在 `<base href>` 且 `rel` 非绝对时以 base 所在目录为基准，否则用文档目录 / Uses the base href's directory when a base is present and `rel` is not absolute, otherwise the document directory

normalize_rel.brief: 把 rel 属性规范成小写、空格分隔的 token 串 / Normalise a rel attribute into a lowercase space-separated token string

params.rel: in:待规范的 rel 属性值 / rel attribute value to normalise
params.out: out:接收规范串的缓冲区 / Buffer that receives the normalised string
params.out_size: 输出缓冲区容量（字节）/ Capacity of the output buffer in bytes

normalize_rel.note: 合并连续空白、去首尾空白并转小写，使 `rel="ICON"` 与 `rel="shortcut icon"` 可预测比较 / Collapses runs of whitespace, trims it and lowercases, so `rel="ICON"` and `rel="shortcut icon"` compare predictably

rel_has_token.brief: 判断 rel 串是否含指定 token / Test whether a rel string contains a given token

params.rel: 规范化的 rel token 串 / Normalised rel token string
params.token: 要查找的 token（不区分大小写）/ Token to look for (case-insensitive)

rel_has_token.return: 含该 token 返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the token is present, otherwise 0
rel_has_token.note: 按空格分词后逐段比较 / Splits on spaces and compares each field

collect_styles.brief: 递归收集 `<style>` 规则与 `<link rel=stylesheet>` 外链样式 / Recursively collect `<style>` rules and `<link rel=stylesheet>` external sheets

params.engine: 引擎实例，规则累加进 `sheet` / Engine instance, rules are appended to `sheet`
params.node: 开始遍历的 DOM 节点 / DOM node to walk from
params.dir: 解析外链 href 的基准目录 / Base directory used to resolve external hrefs

collect_styles.note: 非 stylesheet 的 `<link>` 记入资源提示表（上限 `HPE_MAX_LINKS`）；外链读取失败打印到 stderr 后跳过 / Non-stylesheet `<link>`s are recorded as resource hints (capped at `HPE_MAX_LINKS`); a failed external read is reported on stderr and skipped

is_style_host.brief: 判断节点是否会增删改样式表 / Test whether a node can add, remove or edit the stylesheet

params.n: 待检查的 DOM 节点 / DOM node to inspect

is_style_host.return: 是 `<style>`/`<link>` 元素或其文本子节点返回 1，否则 0 / 1 for a `<style>`/`<link>` element or its text child, otherwise 0

reflow_for_props.brief: 按属性位集判定所需重排级别 / Classify the reflow level a property bit set requires

params.set: 变更涉及的属性位集 / Bit set of the changed properties
params.set2: 变更涉及的第二组属性位集 / Second bit set of the changed properties

reflow_for_props.return: 所需重排级别 `HPE_REFLOW_*` / The `HPE_REFLOW_*` level required

retval.HPE_REFLOW_LAYOUT: 任一变更属性影响几何（盒度量/位置/流/排版）/ A changed property affects geometry (box metrics, position, flow, typography)
retval.HPE_REFLOW_PAINT: 仅纯视觉属性（颜色/不透明度/阴影）/ Only purely visual properties (colour, opacity, shadow)

reflow_for_props.details: 保守策略：除非每个变更位都确知为纯绘制，整组声明按 `HPE_REFLOW_LAYOUT` 处理 / Conservative: the whole declaration set is treated as `HPE_REFLOW_LAYOUT` unless every changed bit is known to be paint-only.

reflow_for_inline_style.brief: 比较 style 属性新旧值得出重排级别 / Compare old and new `style` attribute values to get the reflow level

params.old_value: 变更前的 style 值，可为 NULL / Previous style value, may be NULL
params.new_value: 变更后的 style 值，可为 NULL / New style value, may be NULL

reflow_for_inline_style.return: 所需重排级别 `HPE_REFLOW_*` / The `HPE_REFLOW_*` level required
reflow_for_inline_style.note: 两份解析后的声明位掩码完全一致时返回 `HPE_REFLOW_NONE` / Returns `HPE_REFLOW_NONE` when both parsed declaration sets carry identical bit masks

reflow_for_attr.brief: 判定某属性变更所需的重排级别 / Classify the reflow level an attribute change requires

params.target: 属性所在 DOM 元素 / DOM element the attribute belongs to
params.name: 属性名 / Attribute name
params.old_value: 变更前的属性值 / Previous attribute value

reflow_for_attr.return: 所需重排级别 `HPE_REFLOW_*` / The `HPE_REFLOW_*` level required
reflow_for_attr.note: `<svg>` 元素（几何存于属性）与 `class`/`id` 变更按 `HPE_REFLOW_LAYOUT`；`style` 走内联比较；其余属性对本引擎无影响返回 `HPE_REFLOW_NONE` / `<svg>` (geometry lives in its attributes) and `class`/`id` changes yield `HPE_REFLOW_LAYOUT`; `style` goes through the inline comparison; other attributes are inert here and give `HPE_REFLOW_NONE`

note_reflow.brief: 把待重排级别抬升到 `need` / Ratchet the pending reflow level up to `need`

params.need: 要达到的重排级别 `HPE_REFLOW_*` / Reflow level to ratchet up to (`HPE_REFLOW_*`)

note_reflow.note: 只抬升不下降；`hpe_engine_flush` 处理后统一清零 / Only ratchets up, never down; `hpe_engine_flush` resets it after acting

dom_is_ancestor.brief: 判断 `anc` 是否为 `node` 自身或其祖先 / Test whether `anc` is `node` itself or one of its ancestors

params.anc: 候选祖先节点 / Candidate ancestor node
params.node: 被检查的节点 / Node being inspected

dom_is_ancestor.return: 是返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it is, otherwise 0

note_reflow_node.brief: 记录需局部重建的盒子树对应的 DOM 节点 / Record the DOM node whose box subtree an incremental rebuild must replace

params.node: 变更涉及的 DOM 节点 / DOM node involved in the change

note_reflow_node.note: 只保留最靠近根的外层候选，深入已记录子树内的变更不会缩小作用域；文本节点上溯到元素；无父的分离节点无盒信息被忽略 / Keeps the outermost candidate so a change nested inside an already-recorded subtree does not narrow the scope; a text node walks up to its element; a detached node (no parent) carries no box information and is ignored

style_sink.brief: DOM 变更汇聚点：分类重排并跟踪样式表编辑 / DOM mutation sink: classify the reflow and track stylesheet edits

params.ud: 宿主回调透传的引擎实例 / Opaque user data, the engine instance
params.target: 变更的目标 DOM 节点 / DOM node the mutation targets
params.name: 变更的属性名（`HPE_MUT_ATTR` 时）/ Attribute name (for `HPE_MUT_ATTR`)
params.old_value: 变更前的旧值 / Previous value
params.removed: 被移除的节点 / Removed node

style_sink.note: 触及 `<style>`/`<link>` 会标记样式表脏并强制定界为全量布局（把 `reflow_node` 置空）；`HPE_MUT_CHILD_LIST` 与 `HPE_MUT_TEXT` 记为其父节点的局部重排 / Touching `<style>`/`<link>` marks the sheet dirty and forces an unbounded LAYOUT (clears `reflow_node`); `HPE_MUT_CHILD_LIST` and `HPE_MUT_TEXT` are recorded as a partial reflow of the parent

refresh_styles.brief: `<style>`/`<link>` 变动后重建作者规则 / Rebuild the author rules after a `<style>`/`<link>` change
refresh_styles.return: 重建了样式表返回 1（调用方须重新级联），否则 0 / 1 when the sheet was rebuilt (the caller must re-cascade), otherwise 0
refresh_styles.note: 从干净表开始：`hpe_css_init` 先追加 UA 规则，再遍历（可能已被脚本编辑的）树收集作者规则；link 提示表重新扫描以免累积 / Starts from a clean sheet: `hpe_css_init` re-adds the user-agent rules, then the (possibly script-edited) tree is walked for author rules; the link hint list is re-scanned so it does not accumulate

restyle_boxes.brief: 按（可能已编辑的）DOM 重算每个盒的样式 / Recompute every box's style from the (possibly edited) DOM

params.box: 起始盒，递归其子树 / Starting box, recursing into its subtree
params.sheet: 用于级联的样式表 / Stylesheet used for the cascade
params.parent: 父盒的计算样式，可为 NULL / Parent box's computed style, may be NULL

restyle_boxes.note: 只覆盖样式、不动几何；纯几何编辑因无相应属性而无操作，因而零代价 / Only styles are overwritten, geometry is untouched; a pure-geometry edit is a no-op with no such property, so it pays nothing

flush_rebuild_layout.brief: 执行 LAYOUT 级 flush 的盒树重建 / Rebuild the box tree for a LAYOUT-level flush

params.scope: 局部重建的 DOM 作用域，NULL 表示整树重建 / DOM scope for a partial rebuild, NULL for a full rebuild

flush_rebuild_layout.note: 有有效 `scope` 且未设 `HPE_NO_PARTIAL` 时走 `hpe_layout_rebuild` 局部子树重建，否则整树重建；`HOPE_TRACE_REFLOW` 打印走了哪条路径 / Does a partial subtree rebuild via `hpe_layout_rebuild` when a valid `scope` exists and `HPE_NO_PARTIAL` is unset, otherwise a full rebuild; `HOPE_TRACE_REFLOW` traces which path ran

clamp_scroll.brief: 把滚动偏移夹到 `[0, content_height - view_height]` / Clamp the scroll offset to `[0, content_height - view_height]`

hpe_engine_flush.brief: 应用自上次以来记录的 DOM 变更 / Apply the DOM mutations recorded since the last call

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL
params.force: 非零请求全量重建（新加载或缩放）/ Non-zero requests a full rebuild (fresh load or resize)

hpe_engine_flush.details: 惰性重排策略：LAYOUT 重建受影响的盒子树（作用域无界时整树）；PAINT 重算样式并重绘；NONE 完全跳过渲染。| Lazy policy: LAYOUT rebuilds the affected box subtree (everything when unbounded); PAINT recomputes styles and repaints; NONE skips the render entirely.
hpe_engine_flush.note: `HPE_FORCE_EAGER` 强制走急切全量路径以便与惰性结果对比；处理后清零 `reflow_need`/`reflow_node`/`mutation_pending` 并按需置 `HPE_DIRTY_FULL` / `HPE_FORCE_EAGER` forces the eager full path so the lazy result can be compared; afterwards `reflow_need`/`reflow_node`/`mutation_pending` are cleared and `HPE_DIRTY_FULL` is set as needed

path_basename.brief: 取路径的最后一段 / Get the final path component
path_basename.return: 末尾的文件名部分，`path` 为 NULL 时返回空串 / The trailing file name, an empty string when `path` is NULL
path_basename.note: 同时识别 `/` 与 `\` 分隔符 / Handles both `/` and `\` separators

hpe_engine_refresh_status.brief: 刷新状态行文本 / Refresh the status-line text
hpe_engine_refresh_status.note: 汇总文件名、尺寸、是否含地址栏、加载/绘制耗时与滚动位置，并在末尾追加粘性加载错误（若有）/ Formats the file name, size, chrome flag, load/paint timings and scroll position, appending the sticky load error when present

hpe_engine_view_height.brief: 取页面视口高度（窗口高减地址栏）/ Get the page viewport height (window height minus chrome)
hpe_engine_view_height.return: 视口高度（像素），不小于 0；`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Viewport height in pixels, never below 0; 0 when `engine` is NULL

dump_boxes.brief: 递归打印盒树及行/文本段（调试）/ Recursively dump the box tree with lines and runs (debug)

params.box: 起始盒，递归其子树 / Starting box, recursing into its subtree
params.depth: 当前缩进层级 / Current indentation depth

dump_boxes.note: 输出到 stderr；`HOPE_DEBUG` 下由 `load_source` 在加载后调用，供无头诊断 / Writes to stderr; called by `load_source` after a load under `HOPE_DEBUG` for headless diagnostics

collect_script_nodes.brief: 收集子树的 `<script>` 元素 / Collect the `<script>` elements of a subtree

params.node: 开始遍历的 DOM 节点 / DOM node to walk from
params.out: out:接收脚本元素的数组 / Array that receives the script elements
params.max: 数组容量上限 / Maximum number of array entries
params.count: inout:已收集个数 / Number collected so far

collect_script_nodes.note: 按文档顺序填充，最多 `max` 个 / Fills in document order, at most `max` entries

hope_module_load.brief: 模块加载器：解析说明符并读取模块源码 / Module loader: resolve a specifier and read the module source

params.ud: 宿主透传的基础目录 / Opaque user data, the base directory
params.from_dir: 发起导入的模块所在目录，空则用 `ud` / Directory of the importing module, `ud` when empty
params.out_path: out:接收解析后的模块路径 / Receives the resolved module path
params.out_src: out:接收模块源码 / Receives the module source

hope_module_load.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when loaded, otherwise 0
hope_module_load.note: 无扩展名的说明符补 `.js`；裸说明符回退到文档目录；失败时不写出 `out_path` / Appends `.js` to an extension-less specifier; a bare specifier falls back to the document directory; `out_path` is not written on failure

script_source.brief: 读取单个 `<script>` 的源码 / Read one `<script>`'s source

params.node: `<script>` 元素节点 / The `<script>` element node
params.dir: 解析 `src` 的基准目录 / Base directory used to resolve `src`
params.is_module: out:置为非空表示 `type="module"` / Set non-NULL for `type="module"`

script_source.return: 新分配的缓冲区（须 `hpe_free`），无内容返回 `NULL` / A freshly allocated buffer (free with `hpe_free`), `NULL` when there is nothing
script_source.note: 有 `src` 时读文件，否则取内联原始文本 / Reads the `src` file when present, otherwise the inline raw text

run_one_script.brief: 在引擎 JS 上下文中求值一个已收集的 `<script>` / Evaluate one already-collected `<script>` in the engine's JS context

params.engine: 引擎实例，提供 `js` / Engine instance, provides `js`
params.node: 要执行的 `<script>` 元素 / The `<script>` element to run
params.dir: 脚本所在目录 / Directory of the script

run_one_script.note: module 走 `hpe_js_eval_module`，否则 `hpe_js_eval`；错误打印到 stderr 且不中断后续脚本 / Modules go through `hpe_js_eval_module`, otherwise `hpe_js_eval`; an error is printed to stderr and does not stop later scripts

run_scripts.brief: 重建 JS 上下文并执行文档内全部脚本 / Rebuild the JS context and run every script in the document
run_scripts.note: 先销毁旧 JS 上下文；无脚本时不创建上下文直接返回；安装 DOM 绑定与模块加载器后按文档顺序执行（上限 `HPE_MAX_SCRIPTS`）/ Destroys the old JS context first; returns without creating one when there are no scripts; installs the DOM bindings and module loader, then runs them in document order (capped at `HPE_MAX_SCRIPTS`)

dump_dom.brief: 递归打印 DOM 元素与文本节点（调试）/ Recursively dump DOM elements and text nodes (debug)

params.node: 起始 DOM 节点 / Starting DOM node
params.depth: 当前缩进层级 / Current indentation depth

dump_dom.note: 元素打印标签与 class，文本最多打印 40 字节；输出到 stderr / Elements print their tag and class, text is truncated to 40 bytes; writes to stderr

hpe_engine_relayout.brief: 急切重排：无条件全量重建盒树 / Eager relayout: unconditionally rebuild the whole box tree
hpe_engine_relayout.note: 等价于 `hpe_engine_flush(engine, 1)`；供加载、缩放、悬停、定时器等必须重排的路径使用，惰性策略在 `hpe_engine_flush` / Equivalent to `hpe_engine_flush(engine, 1)`; used by paths that must relayout (load, resize, hover, timers), while the lazy policy lives in `hpe_engine_flush`

hpe_engine_create.brief: 创建引擎实例并初始化像素缓冲 / Create an engine instance and initialise its pixel buffer
hpe_engine_create.return: 新引擎实例 / The new engine instance
hpe_engine_create.note: 非正或缺失的宽高分别回退为 800×600 / Non-positive dimensions fall back to 800×600

hpe_engine_destroy.brief: 销毁引擎并释放全部资源 / Destroy the engine and release all resources

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL

hpe_engine_destroy.note: 释放盒树、DOM、样式表、像素缓冲与 JS 上下文，并关闭字体子系统 / Frees the box tree, DOM, stylesheet, pixel buffer and JS context, and shuts the font subsystem down

reset_document.brief: 拆掉上一份文档的全部产物，准备重新加载 / Tear down everything the previous document produced, ready for a new load

params.path: 新文档路径，NULL 表示空白页 / New document path, NULL for the blank page

reset_document.note: 释放旧路径/盒树/DOM 并重建样式表（含 `hpe_css_init` 的 UA 规则）；`path` 为 NULL 时清空路径 / Frees the old path, box tree and DOM and rebuilds the sheet (with the user-agent rules from `hpe_css_init`); a NULL `path` clears the path

parse_document.brief: 解码原始字节、解析 DOM 并解析 `<base href>` / Decode the raw bytes, parse the DOM and resolve `<base href>`

params.src: 原始字节缓冲，函数接管并释放 / Raw byte buffer; ownership is taken and freed
params.size: 缓冲区字节数 / Number of bytes in the buffer
params.path: 文档路径，供相对引用重定基 / Document path, used to rebase relative references

parse_document.note: 按 BOM / `<meta charset>` / UTF-8 校验探测编码并转成 UTF-8 再解析；在收集作者样式前解析 base href，使相对引用正确重定基 / Detects the charset (BOM / `<meta charset>` / UTF-8 validation), decodes to UTF-8 before parsing, and resolves base href before author styles are collected so relative references rebase correctly

install_styles.brief: 收集作者规则并安装 DOM 变更汇聚点 / Collect the author rules and install the DOM mutation sink

params.path: 文档路径，用于解析外链 / Document path, used to resolve external links

install_styles.note: 记录 `author_rule_base` 与样式签名，并注册 `style_sink`，使脚本后续对 `<style>`/`<link>` 的改动保持同步 / Records `author_rule_base` and the style signature, and registers `style_sink` so later `<style>`/`<link>` edits by page scripts stay in sync

debug_dump_document.brief: `HOPE_DEBUG` 下转储 DOM 与前若干条级联规则 / Under `HOPE_DEBUG`, dump the DOM and the first few cascade rules
debug_dump_document.note: 未设置 `HOPE_DEBUG` 时直接返回；最多打印 40 条规则 / Returns immediately when `HOPE_DEBUG` is unset; at most 40 rules are printed

run_test_hooks.brief: 运行 `HOPE_TEST_*` 合成事件测试钩子 / Run the `HOPE_TEST_*` synthetic-event test hooks
run_test_hooks.note: 读取环境变量：`HOPE_TEST_CLICK`（按 id 点击）、`HOPE_TEST_HOVER`（`x,y` 悬停）、`HOPE_TEST_WAIT`（在给定秒数内跑 tick）、`HOPE_TEST_TEXT`（按 id 打印文本）；在排版后调用一次，供无头 `--dump` 验证交互页 / Reads env vars: `HOPE_TEST_CLICK` (click by id), `HOPE_TEST_HOVER` (`x,y` hover), `HOPE_TEST_WAIT` (tick for the given seconds), `HOPE_TEST_TEXT` (print text by id); runs once after layout so headless `--dump` can verify interactive pages

load_source.brief: 共享加载流水线 / Shared load pipeline

params.src: 原始字节缓冲，函数接管并释放 / Raw byte buffer; ownership is taken and freed
params.size: 缓冲区字节数 / Number of bytes in the buffer
params.path: 文档路径，NULL 表示内置空白页 / Document path, NULL for the built-in blank page

load_source.return: 排版出盒树返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when a box tree was produced, otherwise 0
load_source.note: 清错、重置、解析、收集样式，先排版一次（供脚本读取 `clientWidth`/`clientHeight`），跑脚本后再排版一次，最后跑测试钩子；记录加载耗时并刷新状态 / Clears the error, resets, parses and collects styles, lays out once (so scripts can read `clientWidth`/`clientHeight`), runs the scripts and lays out again, then runs the test hooks; records the load time and refreshes the status

hpe_engine_load_file.brief: 加载并排版一个 HTML 文件 / Load and lay out an HTML file

params.path: 要加载的文件路径 / Path of the file to load

hpe_engine_load_file.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when loaded, otherwise 0

retval.1: 已读取并排版 / The file was read and laid out
retval.0: `engine`/`path` 为 NULL 或文件无法打开（错误写入状态行）/ `engine` or `path` is NULL, or the file could not be opened (the error is stored in the status line)

hpe_engine_load_file.note: 启用地址栏时把绝对路径写入地址栏 / Writes the absolute path into the address bar when chrome is enabled

hpe_engine_load_blank.brief: 加载内置空白页 / Load the built-in blank page

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_engine_load_blank.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when loaded, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_load_blank.note: 无文件参数启动时使用；启用地址栏时清空地址并失焦 / Used when the engine starts without a file argument; clears and blurs the address bar when chrome is enabled

hpe_engine_reload.brief: 重新加载当前文档 / Reload the current document

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_engine_reload.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when reloaded, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_reload.note: 无路径时加载内置空白页 / Loads the built-in blank page when there is no path

hpe_engine_resize.brief: 调整窗口与像素缓冲尺寸并重排 / Resize the window and pixel buffer and relayout

params.width: 新的窗口宽度 / New window width
params.height: 新的窗口高度 / New window height

hpe_engine_resize.note: 宽高非正或与当前完全一致时直接返回；否则重设缓冲、重排并刷新状态 / Returns early for non-positive or unchanged dimensions; otherwise resizes the buffer, relayouts and refreshes the status

hpe_engine_scroll_by.brief: 按行滚动页面 / Scroll the page by a number of lines

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL
params.lines: 滚动的行数，可正可负 / Number of lines to scroll, may be negative

hpe_engine_scroll_by.note: 一行等于 `HPE_SCROLL_LINE_PX` 像素；夹到合法范围后取整到整像素，使损伤矩形路径与全量重绘逐字节一致；仅在未脏时置 `HPE_DIRTY_SCROLL` / One line is `HPE_SCROLL_LINE_PX` pixels; the offset is clamped then snapped to whole pixels so the damage-rect path stays byte-identical to a full repaint; only sets `HPE_DIRTY_SCROLL` when not already dirty

dirty_disabled.brief: 查询是否禁用损伤矩形滚动（`HPE_NO_DIRTY`）/ Test whether damage-rect scrolling is disabled (`HPE_NO_DIRTY`)
dirty_disabled.return: 禁用为 1，否则 0 / 1 when disabled, otherwise 0
dirty_disabled.note: 环境变量只读一次并缓存，作为基准对比用 / The environment variable is read once and cached, as a benchmark aid

collect_fixed_boxes.brief: 收集 `position:fixed` 的盒 / Collect `position:fixed` boxes

params.box: 起始盒，递归其子树 / Starting box, recursing into its subtree
params.out: out:接收 fixed 盒的数组 / Array that receives the fixed boxes
params.max: 数组容量上限 / Maximum number of array entries
params.count: inout:已收集个数 / Number collected so far

collect_fixed_boxes.note: 递归子树，最多 `max` 个；供仅滚动的局部重绘使用 / Recurses the subtree, at most `max` entries; used by the scroll-only partial repaint

render_scrolled.brief: 仅滚动的局部重绘 / Scroll-only repaint
render_scrolled.note: 先按滚动差竖直平移已有像素并重绘露出的条带；位移达到整屏则回退为 `hpe_paint_document` 全量；`fixed` 盒不随滚动移动，最后覆盖其区域 / Shifts the existing pixels by the scroll delta then repaints the exposed strip; a delta of a full viewport or more falls back to a full `hpe_paint_document`; `fixed` boxes do not move and their regions are repainted last

hpe_engine_render.brief: 按脏标记把引擎绘制到像素缓冲 / Paint the engine into its pixel buffer according to the dirty flag

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL

hpe_engine_render.note: 脏标记为 `HPE_DIRTY_NONE` 且已绘制过时整帧跳过（使无实际变更的 DOM mutation 免费）；`HPE_DIRTY_CHROME` 只重画地址栏，`HPE_DIRTY_SCROLL` 走 `render_scrolled`（`HPE_NO_DIRTY` 下跳过），否则整帧重绘；结束清零脏标记并记录绘制耗时 / Skips the whole frame when the flag is `HPE_DIRTY_NONE` and a frame exists (making a no-op mutation free); `HPE_DIRTY_CHROME` repaints only the bar, `HPE_DIRTY_SCROLL` goes through `render_scrolled` (skipped under `HPE_NO_DIRTY`), otherwise a full repaint; clears the flag and records the paint time

hpe_engine_pixmap.brief: 取引擎的像素缓冲 / Get the engine's pixel buffer
hpe_engine_pixmap.return: 像素缓冲指针，`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 `NULL` / Pointer to the pixel buffer, `NULL` when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_status.brief: 取状态行文本 / Get the status-line text
hpe_engine_status.return: 状态文本，`engine` 为 NULL 时返回空串 / The status text, an empty string when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_scroll_offset.brief: 取当前纵向滚动偏移 / Get the current vertical scroll offset
hpe_engine_scroll_offset.return: 滚动偏移（像素），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Scroll offset in pixels, 0 when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_document_encoding.brief: 取上次加载文档所用的字符编码 / Get the charset the last loaded document was decoded from
hpe_engine_document_encoding.return: 编码名（如 `utf-8`、`latin1`、`utf-16le`、`utf-16be`），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回空串 / The charset label (e.g. `utf-8`, `latin1`, `utf-16le`, `utf-16be`), an empty string when `engine` is NULL
hpe_engine_document_encoding.note: 直到下次加载前有效 / Valid until the next load

hpe_engine_meta_charset.brief: 查询编码是否来自文档内 `<meta charset>` / Query whether the charset came from an in-document `<meta charset>`
hpe_engine_meta_charset.return: 来自 meta 返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it came from meta, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_meta_charset.note: 与来自 BOM 或 UTF-8 校验的情况区分 / Distinguishes it from a BOM or UTF-8 validation

hpe_engine_base_href.brief: 取解析后的 `<base href>` / Get the resolved `<base href>`
hpe_engine_base_href.return: 绝对基址，文档未声明时返回空串 / The absolute base URL, an empty string when the document declares none

hpe_engine_link_count.brief: 取非 stylesheet 的 `<link>` 资源数 / Get the number of non-stylesheet `<link>` resources
hpe_engine_link_count.return: 记录的资源提示个数（icon/preload/alternate 等），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Number of recorded resource hints (icon/preload/alternate ...), 0 when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_link_at.brief: 取某条资源提示的归一化 rel 与绝对 href / Get a resource hint's normalised rel token and resolved absolute href

params.index: 资源提示下标 / Resource hint index
params.rel: out:接收归一化 rel token 串，可为 NULL / Receives the normalised rel token string, may be NULL
params.href: out:接收解析后的绝对地址，可为 NULL / Receives the resolved absolute URL, may be NULL

hpe_engine_link_at.return: `index` 有效返回 1，越界返回 0 / 1 for a valid `index`, 0 when out of range
hpe_engine_link_at.note: 越界时不写出任何输出 / Nothing is written when the index is out of range

hit_test_box.brief: 在盒树中做命中测试，返回最深命中的盒 / Hit-test the box tree, returning the deepest matching box

params.box: 起始盒，递归其子树 / Starting box, recursing into its subtree
params.x: X 坐标（视口坐标）/ X coordinate in viewport space
params.y_vp: Y 坐标（视口坐标）/ Y coordinate in viewport space
params.scroll: 文档滚动偏移 / Document scroll offset

hit_test_box.return: 命中的盒，未命中返回 `NULL` / The hit box, `NULL` when nothing matched
hit_test_box.note: `fixed` 盒按视口坐标比较，普通流盒按文档坐标（视口 y 加滚动量）；子级优先，最深命中获胜 / `fixed` boxes compare in viewport coordinates, normal-flow boxes in document coordinates (viewport y plus scroll); children are tested first and the deepest match wins

node_from_hit.brief: 由窗口坐标求命中的 DOM 元素 / Resolve the DOM element under a window coordinate

params.x: X 坐标（窗口坐标）/ X coordinate in window space
params.y: Y 坐标（窗口坐标）/ Y coordinate in window space

node_from_hit.return: 命中的元素节点，未命中或落在地址栏内返回 `NULL` / The hit element, `NULL` when nothing matched or the point is inside the chrome strip
node_from_hit.note: 减去地址栏高度后做命中测试；`<svg>` 子树无盒，改由 SVG 模块判定具体图形；非元素节点上溯到元素 / Subtracts the chrome height before hit-testing; an `<svg>` has no boxes for its children so the SVG module decides the shape; non-element nodes walk up to their element

clear_hover_flags.brief: 清除子树的 `:hover` 标记 / Clear the `:hover` flags of a subtree

params.node: 起始 DOM 节点 / Starting DOM node

clear_hover_flags.note: 递归自身及其所有兄弟子树 / Recurses over the node and all its siblings

hpe_engine_mouse_move.brief: 处理指针移动：更新 `:hover` 并派发 `mousemove` / Handle a pointer move: update `:hover` and fire `mousemove`

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 或无盒树时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL or without a box tree
params.x: X 坐标（窗口坐标）/ X coordinate in window space
params.y: Y 坐标（窗口坐标）/ Y coordinate in window space

hpe_engine_mouse_move.return: 需要重绘返回 1（悬停变化或有监听器改动了页面），否则 0 / 1 when a repaint is needed (hover changed or a listener mutated the page), otherwise 0
hpe_engine_mouse_move.note: 地址栏拖选进行中时交给地址栏处理；悬停变化总是强制重排（`:hover` 是选择器），否则仅在监听器产生变更时惰性 flush / Hands off to the address bar while a drag selection is live; a hover change always forces a relayout (`:hover` is a selector), otherwise a listener-driven change is flushed lazily

hpe_engine_tick.brief: 泵到期定时器与 rAF 回调 / Drain due timers and rAF callbacks

params.engine: 引擎实例，无 JS 上下文时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 without a JS context

hpe_engine_tick.return: 有回调运行返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when at least one callback ran, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_tick.note: 有回调时惰性 flush 并刷新状态 / Lazily flushes and refreshes the status when a callback ran

hpe_engine_mouse_event.brief: 派发一次鼠标按下 / 抬起 / Deliver a mouse press/release

params.x: X 坐标（窗口坐标）/ X coordinate in window space
params.y: Y 坐标（窗口坐标）/ Y coordinate in window space
params.button: 鼠标按键（0 = 左键）/ Mouse button (0 = left)
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released

hpe_engine_mouse_event.return: 页面发生变更返回 1（引擎已重排，窗口应重绘），否则 0 / 1 when the page mutated (the engine already relaid-out and the window should repaint), otherwise 0
hpe_engine_mouse_event.note: 等价于修饰键掩码为 0 的 `hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods` / Equivalent to calling `hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods` with a zero modifier mask

hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods.brief: 带修饰键地派发一次鼠标按下 / 抬起 / Deliver a mouse press/release with modifiers

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 或无盒树时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL or without a box tree
params.x: X 坐标（窗口坐标）/ X coordinate in window space
params.y: Y 坐标（窗口坐标）/ Y coordinate in window space
params.button: 鼠标按键（当前未使用）/ Mouse button (currently unused)
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released

hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods.return: 触发监听器或使地址栏失焦返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when a listener fired or the address bar was blurred, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods.note: 落在地址栏条带内或拖选进行中时交给地址栏；点击页面使地址栏失焦；抬起时依次派发 `mousedown`/`mouseup`/`click`，并按记录的变更做惰性 flush / Points inside the chrome strip or an in-progress drag go to the address bar; clicking the page blurs the bar; a release dispatches `mousedown`/`mouseup`/`click` in turn and lazily flushes the recorded mutations

click_element_by_id.brief: 测试钩子：对指定 id 的元素触发一次点击 / Test hook: fire a click on the element with the given id

params.engine: 引擎实例，无 JS 上下文时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 without a JS context
params.id: 目标元素的 id / id of the target element

click_element_by_id.return: 找到并派发了事件返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the element was found and the events dispatched, otherwise 0
click_element_by_id.note: 由 `HOPE_TEST_CLICK` 使用；用广度优先遍历按 id 找元素，再依次派发 `mousedown`/`mouseup`/`click` 并 flush，无需窗口即可走真实事件路径 / Used by `HOPE_TEST_CLICK`; finds the element by id with a breadth-first walk, then dispatches `mousedown`/`mouseup`/`click` and flushes, exercising the real event path without a window

print_text_by_id.brief: 测试钩子：把指定 id 元素的文本内容打印到 stdout / Test hook: print the text content of the element with the given id to stdout

params.id: 目标元素的 id，空则直接返回 / id of the target element, returns early when empty

print_text_by_id.note: 由 `HOPE_TEST_TEXT` 使用；深度优先收集子树文本后换行输出，找不到 id 时打印 `<no element id=...>`；供无头运行断言脚本对 DOM 的修改 / Used by `HOPE_TEST_TEXT`; concatenates the subtree's text and prints it followed by a newline, printing `<no element id=...>` when the id is absent; lets headless runs assert script-driven DOM updates
